codes.TXFLOW_PARSE_ERROR: The document is not valid YAML/JSON or violates the envelope model.
codes.TXFLOW_UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION: The portable api_version is not supported.
codes.TXFLOW_UNKNOWN_FIELD: An extension field was encountered under WARN policy.
codes.TXFLOW_GRAPH_INVALID: Step ordering contains a missing dependency or cycle.
codes.TXFLOW_BINDING_TYPE: A runtime binding does not match its declared type.
codes.TXFLOW_FLOW_OUTPUT_BINDING_MISSING: A flow_output names an output not declared by its producer.
codes.TXFLOW_RESOURCE_MISSING: A logical resource is not registered.
codes.TXFLOW_RESOURCE_UNAUTHORIZED: Server policy does not authorize the logical resource.
codes.TXFLOW_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: An idempotency key was reused for a different canonical request.
codes.TXFLOW_IDEMPOTENCY_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: The bounded in-memory idempotency registry is full; use durable storage or increase its configured capacity.
codes.TXFLOW_RESOURCE_BUSY: A canonical spending resource could not be acquired under policy.
codes.TXFLOW_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Execution cannot safely continue without reconciliation.
codes.EVENTS_COMPACTED: The requested durable event cursor predates the compaction watermark.
codes.TXFLOW_BINDING_MAXIMUM: A numeric binding exceeds its declared maximum.
codes.TXFLOW_BINDING_MAX_LENGTH: A string binding exceeds its declared maximum length.
codes.TXFLOW_BINDING_MINIMUM: A numeric binding is below its declared minimum.
codes.TXFLOW_COMPACTION_NOT_TERMINAL: Only a terminal execution journal can be compacted.
codes.TXFLOW_COMPILATION_FAILED: Compilation failed before execution side effects.
codes.TXFLOW_CONCURRENT_SPENDING_FORBIDDEN: Policy forbids opting out of spending-resource serialization.
codes.TXFLOW_DOCUMENT_KIND: The portable document kind is not TxFlow.
codes.TXFLOW_DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE: The document exceeds the configured parser byte limit.
codes.TXFLOW_ENGINE_FAILURE: The execution engine encountered an unclassified failure.
codes.TXFLOW_EVENT_SEQUENCE: A durable event identity or sequence is invalid or non-monotonic.
codes.TXFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED: Execution ended with a transaction-flow failure.
codes.TXFLOW_EXECUTION_ID_CONFLICT: An execution ID is already associated with different fingerprints.
codes.TXFLOW_EXECUTION_NOT_FOUND: The durable execution does not exist.
codes.TXFLOW_EXPRESSION_IN_KEY: Portable parameter expressions are forbidden in property names.
codes.TXFLOW_EXPRESSION_SYNTAX: Expression syntax belongs to a different document version.
codes.TXFLOW_FENCE_REQUIRED: A durable mutation requires a valid execution fence.
codes.TXFLOW_FLOW_OUTPUT_INVALID: A flow_output reference is structurally invalid.
codes.TXFLOW_FLOW_OUTPUT_NOT_PRIOR: A flow_output reference must name an earlier producer step.
codes.TXFLOW_FLOW_OUTPUT_STEP_MISSING: A flow_output reference names a missing producer step.
codes.TXFLOW_IDENTICAL_RESUBMISSION_FAILED: Resubmission of verified identical signed bytes failed.
codes.TXFLOW_INVALID_INTERPOLATION: A non-string value cannot be interpolated into a larger string.
codes.TXFLOW_LEASE_CONFLICT: Another owner holds the execution lease.
codes.TXFLOW_LEGACY_FORMAT: A preview-format document was decoded through compatibility mode.
codes.TXFLOW_LEGACY_UNUSED_FILTER: A historical legacy dependency filter was ignored because executable predicates cannot be reconstructed.
codes.TXFLOW_LEGACY_VERSION_DEFAULTED: A versionless legacy document was interpreted as version 1.0.
codes.TXFLOW_NON_PORTABLE_FACTORY: A Java transaction factory has no portable representation.
codes.TXFLOW_OUTPUT_EXPECT_UNSUPPORTED: The requested output-selector cardinality is unsupported.
codes.TXFLOW_OUTPUT_SELECTOR_REQUIRED: A named output requires a declarative selector.
codes.TXFLOW_PARSE_NULL: The document parsed to a null root.
codes.TXFLOW_PAYLOAD_DIGEST_MISMATCH: Resolved signed bytes do not match the persisted SHA-256 digest.
codes.TXFLOW_PAYLOAD_RESOLVER_REQUIRED: An external signed payload requires a resolver.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT_CAPPE: The confirmation timeout exceeds the server ceiling.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_MAX_STEPS: The definition exceeds the server step limit.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_MODE: The requested chaining mode is not allowed.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_NETWORK: The requested network is not allowed.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_RETRY_CAPPED: The retry count exceeds the server ceiling.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_ROLLBACK_ACTION: The requested rollback action is not allowed.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_ROLLBACK_CYCLES_CAPPED: Rollback recovery cycles exceed the server ceiling.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_ROLLBACK_HORIZON: The requested monitoring horizon is not allowed.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_VALIDITY_PREFERENCE_CAPPED: The requested validity preference exceeds policy.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_VALIDITY_REQUIRED: Policy requires a transaction validity interval.
codes.TXFLOW_POLICY_VALIDITY_WINDOW: The transaction validity interval exceeds policy.
codes.TXFLOW_PREPARED_ATTEMPT_MISSING: No durably prepared attempt exists for the transition.
codes.TXFLOW_PREPARED_PERSISTENCE_FAILED: The signed attempt could not be persisted before submission.
codes.TXFLOW_REQUIRED_BINDING: A required runtime binding is missing.
codes.TXFLOW_RESOURCE_CAPABILITY: A resource lacks a required capability.
codes.TXFLOW_RESOURCE_LEASE_CONFLICT: Another execution holds the spending-resource lease.
codes.TXFLOW_RESOURCE_NETWORK: A resource is not valid for the definition network.
codes.TXFLOW_RESOURCE_REF_INVALID: A logical resource reference has invalid syntax.
codes.TXFLOW_RETRY_BEFORE_SIGNING: A transient pre-signing failure permits rebuilding the step.

codes.TXFLOW_STORED_EXECUTION_TERMINAL: The idempotent execution is already terminal.
codes.TXFLOW_SUBMISSION_ACCEPTED: Submission was accepted and must be reconciled by hash.
